typography.guidelines: Do not exceed text-6xl for Hero headings. Never use Inter for Headings; it is strictly for body copy. Use Manrope for all Headings.

colors.guidelines: Use the exact palette provided. Do not introduce new colors. Ensure minimum 4.5:1 contrast for normal text and 3:1 for large text. Hover states for interactive elements must use the highlight_blue (#168BFF) or a slightly lighter/darker variant.

visual_enhancers.glassmorphism: Use bg-[#030712]/80 with backdrop-blur-xl and a border-b border-[#30394A] for the sticky header. NEVER use pure transparent backgrounds over content.

spacing_and_layout.philosophy: Generous Spacing. Use p-8, p-12, p-16 for structural padding to let content breathe.

motion.philosophy: Subtle, professional, reduced-motion aware. No overwhelming parallax.
motion.entrances: Fade in with slight upward translation (e.g., from opacity 0, translate-y-4 to opacity 1, translate-y-0)

instructions_to_main_agent: Strictly adhere to the exact color hex codes and fonts provided. Do not use generic tailwind colors like 'blue-600'; use the provided primary_blue. You must build out all 9 tabs of the Services Catalog with rich, distinct content for each. Do not use placeholder text for the services. Construct a timeline for 'How we work' and an accordion for the 13 FAQs. Ensure all files are Javascript (.js/.jsx) as requested, NOT Typescript.
UNIVERSAL GUIDELINES FOR MAIN AGENT: You tend to converge toward generic, 'on distribution' outputs. Avoid this.
Dark colors look good when used independently without gradients. DO NOT use dark colors as gradients.
Don't make generic centered layouts. Create depth through layered design elements with z-index hierarchy.
Use glass-morphism effects with backdrop filters (12-24px blur), but ensure backgrounds have some opacity (e.g., bg-[#030712]/80). NO completely transparent backgrounds behind text.
You MUST NOT apply universal transition (e.g., transition: all). Add transitions for specific properties.
You MUST NOT center align the app container in global CSS.
Every interaction needs micro-animations - hover states, transitions.
Use 2-3x more spacing than feels comfortable.
All interactive and key informational elements MUST include a data-testid attribute (e.g., data-testid='hero-cta-button').
Use Lucide React for all iconography.
Important: The project uses .js/.jsx files. When generating Shadcn UI components, output Javascript, NOT Typescript.
